translations.web: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
translations.bsb: At this, the unclean spirit threw the man into convulsions and came out with a loud shriek.
translations.kjv: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
translations.asv: And the unclean spirit, tearing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
